description: This Java class 'Validator' provides static utility methods for validating various data types and objects such as EntityId, UUID, String, long, PageLink, and EntityDataPageLink, primarily used for input validation and consistency checks within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for validating various data objects and parameters used across the Thingsboard server DAO layer.

methods.name: validateEntityId
methods.description: Validates EntityId object; throws IncorrectParameterException if null or invalid.

methods.name: validateString
methods.description: Validates that a String is not null or empty; throws IncorrectParameterException if invalid.

methods.name: validatePositiveNumber
methods.description: Ensures a long value is positive; throws IncorrectParameterException if not.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates UUID or UUIDBased object; throws IncorrectParameterException if null.

methods.name: validateIds
methods.description: Validates a list of UUIDBased objects; throws if list is null, empty, or contains null elements.

methods.name: validatePageLink
methods.description: Validates PageLink object for null, page size, page number, and sort property constraints.

methods.name: validateEntityDataPageLink
methods.description: Validates EntityDataPageLink object for null, page size, page number, and sort key constraints.

methods.name: isValidProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property key matches the PROPERTY_PATTERN regex.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Throws IncorrectParameterException if the provided object is null.
